b: As per title. Product is doing well in its launch country and has a couple of clients in this new region but wants to launch properly and grow into new market. Product is a relatively niche SaaS platform, good product - market fit, been going a few years so service is good once clients are onboard. Small team (under 10 people).

I was headhunted to join as fractional sales lead due to my familiarity with this region’s market for this sort of platform and main buyers. Not been there long - done a few days so far and I work 1-2 days a week - but their ICP seems sensible and once people see the platform and data it produces they’re very interested.

My focus is:
- work current pipeline of deals in this region and either progress them or qualify them out
- work with CMO to build top of funnel for 2 priority sectors with specific messaging / pain points
- build lists of ICPs for those sectors and put into lead gen sequences - lean on credibility, data, insights reports form the platform and case studies to show social proof and impact
- build smaller list of priority warmer prospects and multichannel engage
- networking and events (mostly this will kick off next year as it’ll start to wind down now it’s November) to build brand recognition and presence
What would you focus on? Anything I’m missing? 1-2 days a week soon flies by so I’m trying to prioritise ruthlessly.
